title: helleborine leptochila var. dunensis
intro: Helleborine leptochila var. dunensis, commonly known as the Helleborine, is a type of orchid, specifically a species of the genus Epipactis. The Helleborine is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing inflammation and protecting against cell damage. The plant's therapeutic actions are primarily attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been shown to have antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory effects. Additionally, the Helleborine has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various ailments, including fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions.
